description: 4 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers a readiness-first wave plan, inverting a date-first launch, a retro naming missing audience-by-wave logic, and a German phrasing. Should-not covers the three neighbours the skill routes to (announcement copy, the message stack, retention loops) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: plan the alpha, beta and GA waves for this launch keyed to audience and proof
we picked a launch date first — invert it so an unmet gate stops a wave
the last launch landed soft because nobody knew which audience each wave was for
wir brauchen einen Wellenplan für den Launch, nicht nur ein Datum
write the announcement email for the feature we shipped yesterday
lock the primary message and the three supporting ones before we write anything
design the loop that brings users back in week two
our staging database needs a schema migration before Friday
